acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Host Ira Glass gives an update on his health status after going into quarantine last week, and David Kestenbaum interviews a 71 year old trying to avoid the virus.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Stephanie Foo talks to a father trying to go about his day while his daughter comes to him over and over, with some things on her mind.
acts.title: Hey Dad. Dad!

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: A mom checking in on her son. A son figuring out who he can talk to about his mom. Producer Sean Cole is the son.
acts.title: Call Me Maybe

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Ira calls up his mother Shirley Glass after unexpectedly finding her quoted as a “sexpert” in Marie Claire magazine, back in 1996. One of the first stories we did on our show.
acts.title: Mom

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: Producer Neil Drumming tells the story of his dad and his family’s timeshare in Orlando, Florida.
acts.title: It Takes a Villa

acts.label: Act Five
acts.desc: Ira talks to his dad about a job he had before Ira was born.
acts.title: Let’s Talk Radio
